text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp began once again to help hone their skills.
Due to an injury last year, I wasn't able to push her too hard, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: You're sure you're fine with it this year?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...The truth is,
I was really frustrated."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Last year, during that vital period of summer growth, all I could do was watch on as they pushed themselves to their absolute limits.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is a great chance to make big changes...
I was looking forward to seeing how to train, too.

Back then,
it seemed like she wasn't paying attention to her surroundings...
but apparently, she had her own thoughts deep down.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Just as I envisioned...
No, I know I can become even stronger than that.
—And so, our literally heated summer training camp began!
